name: Jonathan
summary: A young Levite from Bethlehem-judah, the son of Gershom, who became the hired priest in Micah's house of idols. He later left with the men of Dan, and he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan.

key_moments.title: Hired as Micah's Priest
key_moments.description: A young Levite from Bethlehem-judah came to Micah's house looking for a place to live. Micah offered him ten shekels a year, clothes and food to be his priest, and the Levite was content to stay.

key_moments.title: Blesses the Spies of Dan
key_moments.description: Five men of Dan lodging at Micah's house knew the young Levite's voice and asked what he was doing there. He told them Micah had hired him, and when they asked him to seek God, he told them to go in peace.

key_moments.title: Leaves with the Tribe of Dan
key_moments.description: The men of Dan took Micah's images and asked the priest whether it was better to serve one house or a tribe. His heart was glad, and he went with them.

key_moments.title: Becomes Priest to the City of Dan
key_moments.description: The men of Dan took Laish, renamed it Dan and set up the carved image. Jonathan the son of Gershom and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the captivity.
